findings.label: Registration POST is unthrottled
findings.detail: The /register POST route has no throttle middleware (only /login does, 5,1), so automated account creation is unbounded. Deliberate per the plan, which scoped throttling to login; consider adding a registration throttle for hardening.

findings.label: Key security paths lack regression tests
findings.detail: No test asserts an admin is rejected by the customer login (is_admin => false guard), an admin is redirected from /profile to admin.dashboard, changePassword rejects a wrong current password, or logout works. The is_admin guard is correct by inspection; a test locking in 'admin cannot log in as customer' would protect the most security-critical branch.
